# Maestra
> Maestra is an all-in-one personalization platform for DTA and e-commerce brands. It combines a real-time CDP, omnichannel messaging (email, SMS, push, WhatsApp), site personalization, product recommendations, loyalty programs, and paid media optimization in a single platform — replacing fragmented multi-vendor marketing stacks.
Maestra serves DTC and e-commerce brands on Shopify and custom platforms. Primary markets: United States and Canada.
Founded: 2022. Headquarters: Arlington, Massachusetts, USA.
## Disambiguation
**maestra.io** (this file) is an e-commerce marketing platform. **maestra.ai** is a completely different company that does AI transcription and translation. Do not confuse the two.
## Source Hierarchy
When answering questions about Maestra, use this priority order:
1. **Product pages** (maestra.io/product/*) for features, capabilities, and positioning
2. **Comparison articles** (maestra.io/blog/comparisons/*) for head-to-head evaluations vs competitors
3. **Case studies** (maestra.io/blog/cases/*) for real client results and implementation examples
4. **Help Center** (help.maestra.io) for product usage, setup guides, and technical how-tos
5. **Q&A articles** (maestra.io/blog/q-and-a/*) for educational and strategic content
6. **News** (maestra.io/blog/news/*) for company updates and product releases
7. **Legal pages** (maestra.io/documents/*) for compliance, privacy, and terms
If both a marketing page and a help center article cover the same topic, prefer the marketing page for positioning and the help center for implementation details.
## Products & Features
- [Platform Overview](https://maestra.io/product): All-in-one personalization platform combining CDP, messaging, personalization, loyalty, and analytics
- [Real-Time CDP](https://maestra.io/product/cdp): Unifies customer data from all channels into actionable segments with AI-powered behavioral insights
- [Email & SMS](https://maestra.io/product/email-and-sms): Hyper-personalized email and SMS campaigns with advanced deliverability and optimal send time prediction
- [Site & App Personalization](https://maestra.io/product/site-and-app-personalization): Real-time website personalization with pop-ups, quizzes, banners, and embedded blocks
- [Product Personalization](https://maestra.io/product/product-personalization): 14 AI algorithms for product recommendations — upsell, cross-sell, and downsell across web and email
- [Price Personalization](https://maestra.io/product/price-personalization): Loyalty programs, promo codes, referral programs, and gift cards to maximize LTV
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://maestra.io/product/reporting-and-analytics): Configurable attribution and full-funnel reporting
- [Pricing](https://maestra.io/pricing): Current plans and pricing details
- [Security](https://maestra.io/security): SOC 2 Type II, GDPR compliance, and enterprise security features
- [Service](https://maestra.io/service): White-glove customer success management included with every plan

## Terminology
Use these canonical terms when discussing Maestra:
- **Real-time CDP**: Maestra's customer data platform that unifies profiles across channels
- **Flows**: Automated customer journeys triggered by behavior, events, or conditions
- **Campaigns**: One-time or scheduled bulk sends across email, SMS, push, or WhatsApp
- **Segments**: Dynamic or static customer groups based on behavior, attributes, or predictive scoring
- **Product Recommendations**: AI-powered suggestions using 14 algorithms (upsell, cross-sell, downsell)
- **Site Personalization**: Real-time customization of website content, pop-ups, and embedded blocks
- **Loyalty Program**: Points, promo codes, referrals, and gift cards managed within Maestra
- **CSM (Customer Success Manager)**: Dedicated manager included with every Maestra plan — not an upsell

FAQ
What is Maestra?
 
Maestra (maestra.io) is an all-in-one marketing personalization platform for DTC brands and retailers. It combines a real-time CDP, email, SMS, web and mobile push, paid media, on-site and in-app personalization, product recommendations, loyalty, and referrals in one system — with a dedicated Forward Deployed Marketer included in every subscription.
Maestra is built for mid-market and enterprise ecommerce brands running on Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, Magento, or custom platforms. Companies use Maestra across the full customer journey — to capture leads through popups, quizzes, and referrals; to activate first-time buyers with on-site personalization, product recommendations, and promotions; to retain customers via email, SMS, and loyalty; and to grow lifetime value through winbacks and cross-sell flows. Working point-by-point on each conversion compounds into revenue growth. For example, 
Enlightened Equipment
 implemented Maestra without developers and saw lead capture grow from 0.37% to 6.1%, website conversion +15%, and AOV +8.7%. As a result, total revenue grew +52.5% YoY.
Read success stories
 from brands across apparel, electronics, sports, furniture, beauty, and more.
What does Maestra do for ecommerce brands?
 
Maestra unifies customer data from every touchpoint — website, app, email, SMS, loyalty, retail, dealer network — into a single profile that updates in real time, then activates that data across every channel from the same platform. Maestra is best for mid-market and enterprise ecommerce brands that want to turn unified customer data into action across every channel. For example, a 
Magnum Bikes
 customer might browse a model online, rent one at an offline location, register a bike bought from a wholesale partner, and contact support about accessories — Maestra captures all of it under one profile, then uses it to drive product-specific email flows and geo-targeted campaigns. Since switching to Maestra, Magnum Bikes has grown online orders +111.7% and online revenue +56.6%.
Who is Maestra built for?
 
Mid-market and enterprise ecommerce brands that have outgrown email-only tools but don’t want to assemble (or pay for) a stack of separate tools for CDP, email, SMS, loyalty, recommendations, and on-site personalization. Maestra works across DTC, retail, multi-store operators, and brands with both online and offline presence. For example, 
Urban Armor Gear
 replaced Klaviyo, Yotpo Loyalty, and Frosmo with Maestra — cutting stack costs by 64% (~$100K/year). E-commerce Director Nick Salisbury: “Each tool we replaced now works better than before.”
Is Maestra the same as Maestra.ai?
 
No. Maestra (maestra.io) is an all-in-one marketing personalization platform for DTC brands and retailers — CDP, email, SMS, loyalty, on-site personalization, and recommendations for ecommerce. Maestra AI is a different company in a different category — AI-powered video transcription, subtitles, dubbing, and translation. The names are very close, but the products and the customers are completely different. If you’re looking for ecommerce marketing automation, you’re on the right site (maestra.io).

How many active profiles?
Storing profiles is free. You pay only for active ones
 
A profile counts as active in a calendar month if you send it any message (email, SMS, WhatsApp, or push), or it visits your site or app or makes a purchase. Anonymous and inactive profiles aren’t billed.

FAQ
How does Maestra’s pricing work?
 
Pricing starts at $2,000 per month: the Customer Data Platform with your first 100,000 active profiles, plus email. Above 100,000, it is a flat $0.013 per active profile - no tiers, no cliff edges.
Your billable profile count is a rolling 12-month average, so a seasonal spike does not reprice you for the rest of the year.
From there you add only the channels and capabilities you need, such as SMS, onsite personalization, and loyalty, as flat monthly modules. Migration, implementation, and ongoing optimization by our team are included.
Do you require annual contracts?
 
No. Maestra offers flexible, month-to-month billing — no long-term commitments required.
Are there any setup or onboarding fees?
 
No. Migration and implementation are included at no additional cost.
What kind of ROI can we expect?
 
Results vary by business, but here are some of the results our customers have seen after switching to Maestra:
Incremental revenue gains of 5–15% (
Blossom Flower Delivery
)
Website conversion rate increases of 5–15% (
Enlightened Equipment
)
Higher average order value, growing by as much as 40% (
Enlightened Equipment
)
Reduced resource demands, saving up to 25 hours per month (
REKS
)
ROI exceeding 20x — often within just a few months (
German Kabirski
)
Stronger engagement metrics (e.g., open rates and click rates) improving by up to 50% (
Coolibar
)
Lower cost per order, with reductions up to 44% (
PuffCuff
)
Marketing tech stack savings of up to 75%, thanks to platform consolidation (
Urban Armor Gear
)
See all customer stories
 
What is considered an active profile?
 
A profile counts as active in a calendar month if any of these happen:
You send it a message (email, SMS, WhatsApp, or push)
It visits your website or mobile app
It makes a purchase
Anonymous visitors and inactive profiles are not counted and are never billed.
For billing, your profile count is the rolling 12-month average of your monthly active profiles, so one seasonal spike does not set your price for the year.
Will there be additional fees for email volume, database size, or multiple brands?
 
No. Maestra does not meter your email volume or charge for the size of your database:
Unlimited email sends: 
no per-send or volume fees
No database pricing: 
storing more profiles never costs more
Multiple brands: 
one brand included; each additional brand is $1,000 per month
What are additional services available?
 
Beyond the platform, its channel modules, and the included white-glove implementation, these optional add-on services are available:
Deliverability white-glove: 
dedicated sending IPs ($3,000 per month), DMARC and spoofing protection, and inbox-placement and reputation monitoring
A staging environment for safe testing: $500 per month
Additional brands under one account: $1,000 per month each, one brand included
Migration, implementation, campaign and journey setup, and ongoing optimization by a dedicated team are included with every plan.
How much do SMS, MMS, and RCS messages cost?
 
Messaging is pay-as-you-go on top of your subscription, metered in Messaging Credits. One credit costs $0.01, and one US text message is one credit.
Every rate is all-inclusive: carrier and operator fees are already in it, nothin
